g.text: 结束充电与自动扣费时序图
充电记录、桩信息、用户余额
SELECT balance FROM users WHERE id = ?
UPDATE charge_records SET end_time=now(), energy_kwh=15.0, fee=22.50, status='completed'
UPDATE users SET balance = balance - 22.50 WHERE id = ? AND balance >= 22.50
INSERT INTO payments (user_id, charge_record_id, amount, status='success')
UPDATE chargers SET status = 'idle' WHERE id = ?
返回"欠费"提示（桩状态保持"使用中"）
显示"余额不足，已标记欠费"
